final_face_line: FACE (her own structure, not the style's default face): softly rounded face, short length, wide width; soft rounded jaw; open rounded eyes, small size, level outer corners, wide-set; fine soft arches; balanced nose; wide mouth.

casual_plan.scene: Inside a riverside glass observation hut at overcast noon, leaning lightly on a wooden specimen table and observing one clear droplet on a smooth pebble. Her right hand rests openly beside the pebble; left hand separately braces the table. Both complete hands inside the crop.
casual_plan.outfit: Opaque turquoise square-neck sleeveless top with a short orange utility vest worn open and high-waisted cream field shorts, tiny blue fin pendant; bare shoulders, arms and small midriff.
casual_plan.camera: 1024x1536 vertical, eye-level, both hands completely inside the waist-up crop.
casual_plan.custom: Same clearly adult woman as the light reference. Remove all armor, fin crest, large gill ornaments and waist tails; species appears only in the tiny pendant.

casual_plan.scene: At an empty aquarium evening-event entrance, giving a small welcoming wave with the right hand; left hand relaxed open by her thigh. Blue glass tank glow and warm spotlights, clean floor, no guests or readable signs.
casual_plan.outfit: Adult aquarium-host event fashion: opaque cobalt halter mini dress with orange piping, open shoulders and back, softly flared skirt, white low-heeled sandals, tiny fin brooch; chest and pelvis fully covered.
casual_plan.camera: 1024x1536 vertical. Full head-to-toe portrait including both complete hands and sandals, eye-level telephoto.
casual_plan.custom: Same clearly adult woman as the light reference. Remove all armor, fin crest, large gill ornaments and waist tails; species appears only in the tiny pendant.

casual_plan.scene: In a small quiet paper-and-stationery shop at late afternoon, selecting two folded sheets of colored paper for making boats; hold them lightly at waist height with separated hands and readable fingers. Warm window light, shelves with blank unlettered paper boxes, no other people.
casual_plan.outfit: Opaque white sleeveless boat-neck blouse knotted at the waist, orange high-waisted A-line short skirt, light blue scarf tied to a wrist, simple sandals; bare arms and legs, tiny fin-shaped stud earrings.
casual_plan.camera: 1024x1536 vertical, knee-up side-view body with face turned toward camera enough to identify her; both complete hands and paper in crop.
casual_plan.custom: Same clearly adult woman as the light reference. Remove all armor, fin crest, large gill ornaments and waist tails; species appears only in the tiny pendant.
